messages:
Maria (SRE): FYI postmortem is up: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-03-throughput-spike — main follow-up is SLO/SLA adjustments and recurring batch pattern analysis.
Alex C: looking now. Do we want to change the throughput SLO or just tweak alert thresholds? :thinking_face:
David N: From the telemetry it looks like P95 is fine but P99/P99.9 spikes during the 03:00 UTC batch window. Error budget burn hit 42% yesterday.
Priyanka S: We should track a separate throughput SLI (requests/s sustained) and a tail-latency SLI (P99.9). Current SLOs only consider avg latency which hides these bursts.
Maria (SRE): Agreed. Proposal: add "tail_latency.p99_9" SLO at 99.5% (meaning months with >0.5% breaches count) and a throughput SLO for sustained 5m windows >= baseline-10%. Also update alerts to trigger before user-facing SLAs breach.
Alex C: Can you paste the PromQL we'll use for the P99.9? I can wire the dashboard and alerts.
Maria (SRE): Sure — use this for p99.9 over 5m windows:
```
histogram_quantile(0.999, sum(rate(request_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, route))
```
And for sustained throughput drop: 
```
avg_over_time(rate(requests_total[1m])[5m:1m])
```
David N: I'll own the alert rule changes. Plan: create a preemptive alert at P99.9 > 1200ms for 3/5 windows, and a throughput alert if 5m sustained drop > 25% vs baseline for >10m. Will push to staging by Thu EOD.
sre-oncall-bot: Incident report link posted to channel: https://redwood.incidents/INC-2026-0322-03 — severity: P2 — assigned: David N.
Priyanka S: We also need a long-term remediation: batch job coordination. The recurring pattern shows multiple customers kicking off heavy index jobs at 02:50-03:10 UTC. Ops should add jitter and rate-limit.
Alex C: I'll add a dashboard panel: "Throughput & Tail Latency (by hour)" and a daily automated report showing spikes. Dashboard id will be: grafana/d/abcd1234/throughput-tail.
Maria (SRE): Action items summary: 
- David N: update alert rules + push to staging (due Thu EOD)
- Alex C: dashboard panel + daily spike report (due Fri EOD)
- Priyanka S: coordinate with Batch Infra to add jitter/rate-limit and propose schedule changes (due Mon)
- Maria (SRE): Update postmortem with SLO proposal and get PM sign-off on SLO changes (due Mon)
Please react with :thumbsup: if you accept.
David N: 👍 accepting.
Alex C: :thumbsup: will do.
Priyanka S: Accepting, will start sync with infra now.
Maria (SRE): I'll open a tracking ticket and link it in the postmortem. Ticket: https://redwood.internal/issues/RED-4287 — putting owners and dates there.
ops-runbook-bot: Runbook NOTE: Add section "03:00 UTC batch spike" with mitigation steps (scale pool, roll to fallback model, alert contact list).
Maria (SRE): Quick check — do we want to temporarily relax customer SLA for batch windows or rely on fallback routing? Thoughts?
David N: Prefer routing to fallback model + throttling rather than SLA relaxation. SLA change needs legal/PM and is slower.
Alex C: Agree. I'll implement fallback routing policy to prefer smaller instance types during spikes and test in staging.
Priyanka S: Will also add a nightly job to surface any customers running >X concurrent heavy jobs at 03:00 UTC so we can proactively reach out.
Maria (SRE): Great. We'll reconvene next Tue 11:00 for SLO sign-off review. If anyone needs to change deadlines ping me.
sre-oncall-bot: Reminder set for 2026-03-24T11:00:00Z (SLO sign-off review).
Maria (SRE): Thanks everyone — short and sharp thread. Logging actions to postmortem now.
